Subject: Draft marketplace copy + co-sell playbook for review

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached are two items we promised to get over: a first-pass product page copy for the AWS Marketplace listing (listing_copy_v1.docx) and an early co-sell playbook (co-sell_playbook_draft.pdf) that maps GTM motions and field handoffs. High level asks: 

- Could you skim the hero one-liner and three benefit bullets and tell us what lands / what doesn't from Acme's perspective?
- Any must-have brand language or compliance snippets from your marketplace team we should preserve?
- Can we confirm the initial entitlement model (trial + 1 paid SKU) so we can align the pricing callouts?

Proposed next steps: if we get feedback by EOD Tuesday the 8th, Kimberly and I will push updated copy and a hero image option. Would love to lock a 30-min sync next Wed to finalize entitlements and the co-sell contact list.

Attachments: listing_copy_v1.docx (draft), co-sell_playbook_draft.pdf (work-in-progress)

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

—Michael

Subject: Re: Draft marketplace copy + co-sell playbook for review

Thanks Michael — good packet, appreciated. Quick high-level notes inline, then an ask from our procurement/marketplace side.

- Hero/one-liner: lean into ROI for search relevance and inference cost savings. Recommend swapping the lead line to call out "up to 3x throughput" only if you have a verified benchmark; otherwise use "measurable latency and cost improvements."
- Bullets: second bullet should emphasize "data residency and VPC-friendly private deployments" (that is a gating item for some of our customers).
- Co-sell playbook: looks sensible. Suggest adding a pre-sales checklist for our field (required legal checklist for marketplace offers) and a short section on marketplace listing images (we have strict thumbnail rules).

Procurement note: our procurement team will require an estimated monthly spend table for the first 12 months to approve co-sell commitments; can your team provide an estimate by next Friday? Also include a short statement on data retention and audit logs (SOC2 alignment).

I've attached Acme brand guidelines (acme_brand_guidelines.pdf) to make the copy changes easier.

Subject: Re: Draft marketplace copy + co-sell playbook for review

Noted — thanks Samantha for the brand guide. I made a few inline edits to the hero and the three bullets (pushed an updated hero_image_v2.png for thumbnail tests). Summary of changes I recommend: 

- Hero: "Production-grade LLM inference with predictable latency and cost — deploy hosted, dedicated, or private." (keeps parity with Redwood messaging while surfacing deployment flexibility).
- Bullet 1: Performance claim softened to "reduces per-request latency and cost for common production workloads" (avoids an unverified 3x claim).
- Bullet 2: Adds phrase "VPC-friendly private deployments" per Samantha's note.
- Bullet 3: Adds a short line about observability: "token-level cost and latency breakdowns for engineering teams."

Action items: 
- Marissa: can you update the listing tile copy and prepare two headline variants for A/B testing? Also please start a short 12-month spend estimate draft (use the usage profile in the co-sell_playbook_draft).
- Stephanie: I'll need a 1-pager on SOC2 + data retention language we can paste into the listing legal section.

I've attached hero_image_v2.png as a suggested thumbnail.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Marketplace Product Manager, Redwood Inference
